details: For every sign matrix, $\mathrm{VC}\leq\mathrm{DSR}\leq2\mathrm{VC}+1$. The bound $\mathrm{DSR}\le2\mathrm{VC}+1$ rules out an unbounded affine gap, including when VC is zero.
name: Dual Sign Rank / VC Dimension
proof: This is the first inequality of Proposition 1, which identifies dual sign rank with the VC dimension of the matrix obtained by adjoining the negated rows.
